{{Top|leg}}
A '''speederboat''' was an aquatic vehicle using [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology.

They were a common sight in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. [[Mix Liddell]] owned a speederboat named [[Ertine (speederboat)|''Ertine'']]. The local droid [[MD-0C6]] used the repulsor units of one discarded speederboat on himself, to increase his mobility.
